title: Red Team Adversarial Emulation and Security Audit
raw_text: Apex Defense Tech is soliciting proposals for a full-scope red team security assessment and physical/digital penetration testing engagement. The target environment includes air-gapped dev labs, active directory infrastructure, and internal C2 detection posture.
requirements: Adversarial red team emulation and penetration testing
Active Directory and C2 security assessment
SOC detection and incident response capability evaluation
